requirement: Tracy keeps working when the Joomla Claude Cowork release stops carrying contract profiles: the import puts the site's profile into the component from its release asset, and STAB-1 reads the index

oracle.invariant: S1: every named test reports ok; for a slim package (administrator/lib/contracts.json, no contract folder) the picked profile and the one it names are put into packages/com_claudecowork.zip under administrator/lib/contracts/<id>/ and the result reads back under Python zipfile and PHP ZipArchive; an asset whose sha256 or length differs from the index is dropped; an unreachable asset leaves the package as released and the install still ends ok; STAB-1 says carries for an indexed id and lacks for an absent one; pin-joomla-cowork checks a slim release's profiles from their assets and refuses a mismatch
